subject.title: Support Workers AI model selection during onboard

question: Should Workers AI support be a bounded mode of the existing official Cloudflare provider, or should it land only as part of the broader multi-provider AI Gateway bridge tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94554?
rationale: The choice determines the permanent provider id, endpoint/protocol mapping, authentication headers, model-catalog ownership, and whether this issue remains a separate implementation unit.

options.title: Consolidate into the bridge
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94554 for the provider-contract design and retain this issue as the non-interactive Workers AI acceptance criterion.

options.title: Add a bounded Workers AI mode
options.body: Keep the Anthropic default and add an explicit provider-owned Workers AI mode with its own endpoint, protocol, credentials, and model input.

options.title: Support only custom providers
options.body: Keep the official plugin Anthropic-only and document an exact custom-provider onboarding and configuration workflow for Workers AI.

recommendation.title: Consolidate into the bridge
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94554 for the provider-contract design and retain this issue as the non-interactive Workers AI acceptance criterion.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the most recent product-boundary review on this issue and can coordinate the overlapping Cloudflare provider direction.
